generate_usd_trajectory: generate a USD trajectory file from a MuJoCo MJCF model with specified duration and framerate
create_USDExporter: create a USDExporter instance from a MuJoCo model with output directory and camera names
update_scene: update the USD scene with MuJoCo simulation data at each frame
add_light: add a dome light to the USD scene with position and intensity
save_scene: save the USD scene to a file with the specified extension
